review.abstention_reason: The change is a warehouse-source connector implementation for EZOfficeInventory, not a PostHog core capability. The diff adds support for three new tables (reservation_requests, custom_roles, work_orders) and their associated fan-out and documentation. While this could benefit PostHog warehouse customers using this connector, the change does not demonstrate a broader PostHog system
